data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing different types of charts built purely in dart.
data.what_it_does: Multi-charts provides purely Dart-built charts for Flutter, currently supporting Radar and Pie charts. It includes options for data points, labels, styling customization, legends, and animations.
use_when: You need to display a Radar or Pie chart in your Flutter application
You want customizable chart colors, labels, and legends without native dependencies
avoid_when: You need more advanced chart types like line, bar, or scatter plots
You need highly complex charting libraries with extensive interactions and zoom capabilities
strengths: Pure Dart implementation works across all Flutter platforms
Includes support for animations and customizable styles
Supports customizable legends for pie charts
weaknesses: Very limited chart types (only Radar and Pie charts currently supported)

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a wider variety of modern charts like line, bar, pie, and scatter plots.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers an extensive and enterprise-grade suite of charts with high performance.

alternatives.name: pie_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Focuses specifically on pie charts with rich legend and animation options.

data.minimal_example:
RadarChart(
  values: [10, 20, 30, 40, 50],
  maxValue: 50,
  labels: ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E'],
  animate: true,
)
